module autovcoder_000176 (
    input  [7:0] io_in,
    output [7:0] io_out
);

  wire clk = io_in[0];
  wire reset = io_in[1];
  wire ir = io_in[2];
  wire [6:0] led_out;
  assign io_out[6:0] = led_out;

  wire valid;
  wire [5:0] command;
  wire control;
  reg control_d;
  localparam [5:0] RC5_INCR_VOLUME = 16;
  localparam [5:0] RC5_DECR_VOLUME = 17;

  rc5 rc5 (
      .i_clk(clk),
      .i_rst(reset),

      .i_rc5(ir),

      .o_valid  (valid),
      .o_command(command),
      .o_control(control)
  );

  reg [3:0] counter;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
      counter   <= 0;
      control_d <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      if (valid) begin
        control_d <= control;

        if (control != control_d) begin
          if (command == RC5_INCR_VOLUME) begin
            counter <= counter + 1;
          end else if (command == RC5_DECR_VOLUME) begin
            counter <= counter - 1;
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end

  // instantiate segment display
  seg7 seg7 (
      .counter (counter),
      .segments(led_out)
  );

endmodule
